title: Junior doctors protest in Kolkata demanding revocation of show-cause notices

tea.why: Junior doctors are protesting against show-cause notices issued to eight interns after a press meet about a stampede.
tea.want: They demand the immediate withdrawal of the show-cause notices issued to the interns.
tea.changed: Nov 18: Junior doctors staged a protest outside the principal's room and reportedly gheraoed the principal for hours.

summary: Junior doctors and interns at Medical College and Hospital in Kolkata staged demonstrations on Wednesday evening to demand the revocation of show-cause notices issued to eight interns. The notices were served after the interns held a news conference on October 18 questioning the shifting of victims from the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal stampede to private facilities instead of government hospitals. Protesters gheraoed the principal's office and demanded the notices be withdrawn, claiming the investigation was unfair and medical services were not disrupted. Tensions also rose during the demonstrations following a confrontation on campus involving alleged supporters of the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad, according to officials and reports.
demands: Revoke the show-cause notices issued to eight interns
Provide a copy of the inquiry committee report
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Junior doctors staged a protest on the campus and outside the principal's room, demanding the withdrawal of show-cause notices.
